dz: 葡萄牙人巴托洛梅乌·迪亚斯 (Bartolomeu Dias) 绕过好望角后抵达莫塞尔湾，成为已知的第一个向南航行的欧洲人。
de: Bartolomeu Dias of Portugal lands in Mossel Bay after rounding the Cape of Good Hope, becoming the first known European to travel so far south.
